title: Causal Order Monotonicity and Distributed State Machine Invariants in a Ruby Agent Memory as Source Code: A DSL for Neurons, Synapses and a Aether-Chain Ledger
topic: Agent Memory as Source Code: A DSL for Neurons, Synapses and a Hash-Chained Ledger
author: Mateus Yonathan
journal: Polyglot Systems Lab Agentic Research Preprints
description: We present a domain-specific language (DSL) that encodes neural agents as immutable source code, coupling a neuron--synapse graph with a Aether-Chain Ledger ...
abstract: We present a domain-specific language (DSL) that encodes neural agents as immutable source code, coupling a neuron--synapse graph with a Aether-Chain Ledger that records every structural modification. The DSL is implemented in Ruby and leverages a balanced search index to maintain $O(\log N)$ lookup and insertion for neuron identifiers, while the ledger guarantees $O(1)$ amortized append and $O(N)$ memory. We formalize causal order invariants that preserve ledger consistency and neuron state propagation, and we prove that the height of the search index remains bounded by $\lceil\log_2 N\rceil+1$. Static abstract-syntax-tree inspection confirms the implementation satisfies the stated asymptotic bounds. The source code is publicly available at \url{https://github.com/myonathanlinkedin/ruby-algorithms-lab/tree/main/algorithms/20261008_190212_agent_memory_as_source_code__a}.
